geometry.note: 'verified' because representation is 'surveyed' from a rank <=10 official source (KM3NeT-It site page, rank 1), corroborated by an independent rank-4 design report (the Letter of Intent) giving the same figure.

method: Point coordinate taken directly from the KM3NeT-It research-infrastructure page's published '36°16' N 16°06' E', corroborated verbatim by the Letter of Intent for KM3NeT 2.0 (arXiv:1601.07459). Same value already recorded on site:km3net-arca-capo-passero. accuracy_m matches that record's own precision_m (2000 m), reflecting the arc-minute precision of the published coordinate.
name: KM3NeT/ARCA site (surveyed point)
notes: No checks[] row: a Point has no length/area/span to cross-check independently; the coordinate itself is corroborated by two independent official sources (site page + Letter of Intent), which is why confidence is 'verified' rather than 'approximate'.

summary.plain: The published seabed location of the KM3NeT/ARCA neutrino telescope, about 100 km off Sicily and 3500 m down.
